name: Hokkaido Grid Addresses
description: Hokkaido's grid towns, named by 条 (the row) and a direction, with 丁目 as the column: 札幌's 北1条西2丁目, 旭川's 6条通, 帯広's 西5条南. The 条 and its number stay in the town; the 丁目 is the chome. Original case written for this corpuss; shapes follow Japan Post's guidance on writing an address (郵便番号・住所の書き方), described in our own words; nothing copied.
